user.title: Create virtual device
user.description: Name the virtual device. Add its entities afterwards via **Configure** on the integration entry.

init.title: Manage virtual device
init.description: Changes only take effect after **Save and finish**.

add_entity.title: Type and name
add_entity.description: Any number of virtual entities can be built from the same source, for example a text and a number.

entity_source.title: Source and transformation
entity_source.description:
The source entity is never modified. The template can use `value` (state or attribute), `state` and `attributes`.

Examples:
- `{{ value.split(' - ', 1)[-1] }}` turns "18 - Running" into "Running"
- `{{ value.split(' - ')[0] }}` returns just "18"
- `{{ value.startswith('18') }}` for a binary sensor

data_description.source_attribute: Optional. Use this attribute instead of the state.
data_description.value_template: Optional. Transforms the value. Without it the value is used unchanged.

entity_details.title: Details
entity_details.description:
Actions forward commands to the source integration. They can use `{{ value }}` (number), `{{ option }}` (select) and `{{ source_entity }}`.

Example for a select: `{{ {'Running': 18, 'Standby': 19}[option] }}`

data_description.options: The value (after the template) must match one option exactly.
data_description.unit_of_measurement: Optional. If a unit or class is set, the value must be numeric.
data_description.state_class: Optional. Use measurement for values that go up and down.

remove_entity.title: Remove entities
remove_entity.description: Only the virtual entities are deleted. The source entities stay untouched.

error.min_greater_max: The maximum must be greater than the minimum.
